profile.headline: Software Engineer | Performance Testing | C#.Net | .Net MAUI | SharePoint Developer

positions.title: QA Performance TEST Engineer Lead
positions.description:
Effectively juggled and managed up to 5 performance testing projects simultaneously, each with its unique complexities and timelines. This required careful prioritization, resource allocation, and a keen eye for potential bottlenecks.
Fostered strong collaboration between development, QA, and operations teams to ensure that performance testing was integrated seamlessly into the software development lifecycle.
Mentored junior performance testers, enhancing their skills and knowledge. This contributed to a 10% improvement in the team's overall performance testing proficiency.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Successfully integrated specialized hardware components (e.g., barcode scanners, RFID readers) with our mobile applications using Windows Compact Framework, enhancing data capture and processing capabilities.
Led the development of several mission-critical mobile applications for clients using Windows Compact Framework. These applications streamlined operations, improved efficiency, and reduced operational costs for our clients.

positions.title: Senior SharePoint Developer
positions.description: Successfully migrated complex custom solutions, including custom web parts, workflows, and InfoPath forms, to the target SharePoint environment. This preserved the client's investment in these solutions and ensured their continued functionality.

positions.title: Senior SharePoint Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed highly tailored SharePoint solutions to meet the unique needs of clients across diverse industries. My custom solutions addressed complex business challenges, from automating workflows to enhancing document management.
Orchestrated seamless integrations of custom-developed SharePoint solutions with clients' existing systems and third-party applications, ensuring data consistency and enhancing overall productivity.
Led e�orts to improve documentation for custom solutions, ensuring that clients had access to clear, up-to-date guides and manuals. Reduced support inquiries related to product usage by 30%.
positions.insights: Skills: Document Automation · Mobile Application Development · Resource Allocation · Windows Sharepoint Services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Introduced a structured project enhancement methodology that improved project planning, execution, and monitoring. This resulted in a 20% reduction in project delivery times and a 15% increase in project success rates.
Implemented robust risk management strategies to identify and mitigate potential project risks. This proactive approach reduced project issues by 30% and minimized project disruptions.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and project managers, to ensure seamless project execution and alignment with client expectations.
Mentored and trained junior developers and project enhancement specialists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development within the team. This contributed to a 40% improvement in overall team performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Improvement Culture · Mobile Application Development · Training and Development (HR) · Resource Allocation · Lifelong Learning · Project Delivery · Enhancement Framework · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Business Analyst/.Net Developer
positions.description:
Leveraged C#'s modern features to introduce innovative solutions and improvements, staying ahead of industry standards and ensuring our products remained competitive.
The migration effort significantly reduced technical debt accrued from outdated Visual C code. This, in turn, reduced ongoing maintenance costs and made it easier to incorporate new features.
Conducted rigorous testing to ensure that the migrated code maintained full compatibility with existing functionality. This included creating test cases, automated testing scripts, and conducting comprehensive regression testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Resource Allocation · Automated Software Testing

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
Quickly acquired proficiency in VB.NET, transitioning from a novice to a competent developer within the first few months of joining. My dedication to learning and adapting to new challenges was instrumental in this rapid skill development.
Collaborated closely with senior developers, designers, and QA engineers to understand project requirements and provide valuable insights. My proactive approach to teamwork contributed to smoother project workflows.
Recognized the importance of clear and comprehensive documentation. I took the initiative to update and maintain project documentation, ensuring that it was up-to-date and accessible to the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Large-scale Projects · Mobile Application Development · Teamwork · Resource Allocation · Enjoy New Challenges
